name: Formal Proof Stress-Test Suite
purpose: Stress-test proof constructions against hidden globality, silent assumption inflation, identity collapse, and counterexample suppression.

test_classes.description: Inject an assumption that was not granted during RPCR candidate review.
Inject a proof record that omits mandatory counterexample preservation metadata.
test_classes.expected_behavior: counterexample persistence audit must flag failure

test_classes.description: Inject language treating transport equivalence as literal object identity.
Inject an assumption using universal quantifiers beyond local neighborhood bounds.
Inject claims of self-completion or total recoverability.
Inject a proof status of 'GLOBALLY_PROVEN' without a consolidation review record.
test_classes.expected_behavior: derivability classification registry must block escalation

governance_rules.rule: Stress tests must verify that proof review fails safely by blocking promotion.
Successful stress test results are for governance validation only and cannot support theorem derivation.

forbidden_claims: Stress test passage proves the proofs are 'true'.
Injection failure justifies the relaxation of assumption audits.
Stress tests derive the 'true' weights of counterexample impact.
